authorization_source.selected_text: Разрешаете разовый план архивирования резервации? После свежих проверок весь прерванный запуск будет сохранён как ABANDONED, затем можно продолжить штатные тесты.

body:
[@Evaler](mention://agent/de4ba430-2182-4085-a148-fa4a3fc8a6f5), фиксирую прямое решение владельца из текущего Codex-чата в ответ на ваш запрос `01a134ea-fe1f-79a7-ac72-2f2d1811935a`: **разрешаю разовый план архивирования указанной резервации стенда**. Владелец подтвердил именно предложенный план, выбрав его в ответе-аннотации и написав «разрешаю».

Маркер решения: LAB57-INTERRUPTED-UNIT-OWNER-APPROVAL-20261013.

Разрешено ровно одно адресное немодельное операторское исключение по приложенному byte-identical proposal SHA256 `464bf627a2a1ee377b4618d126bada6262489f15af592b245ad59f146f7377a6`, из проверенного checkpoint ZIP `af591759e21003775fc364193d865f04fce6fd28ced1d6bb6fb2a8f3cab55729`. Оно относится только к original interrupted unit task `01a134a1-0f47-782c-8d67-9c843c2d25e3`, owner Rich/phase unit, SHA `49522d83318bac29779e497798becb2f799bc84e`, acquiredAt `2026-10-13T09:49:32.777Z`, canonical config `58435fbe4aca6ac2e40629800594526a7cec48af3d9306e02fa5b7163be96d71`, lease device/inode `64512/12748659`, operation guard `64512/12748661`.

Сначала поиск настоящих durable terminal/typecheck/completion/process proofs на исходном execution host. Если их нет, нужны свежие полные process/ancestry/absence проверки, отсутствие active/queued workers и writers, допуск всех профилей/storage/exact container и повторная сверка всех identities/bytes непосредственно перед мутацией. Затем private once receipt ATTEMPTED_BEFORE_MUTATION и атомарное архивирование ВСЕГО исходного stand.lease в отдельный ABANDONED по точному плану, с сохранением guard/owner/acquiredAt/config и всех bytes. Не синтезировать completion/RELEASED/PASS; historical ERROR и cleanup UNKNOWN остаются. Не удалять отдельные файлы, не перепривязывать owner и не затрагивать чужие процессы/профили/leases. Unknown process, mismatch, race, pending worker, existing destination или неполный допуск => STOP/BLOCKED; повтор once после error/crash не разрешён.

Операторский проход ограничен **30 минутами с начала** и прежним общим deadline **2026-10-13T15:33:29.538616Z (18:33 МСК)**; clock и накопленная история не сбрасываются. После проверенного ABANDONED archival и настоящего FREE разрешено предусмотренное планом обычное продолжение: fresh acquire, настоящий supervised unit/typecheck/release и ранее разрешённая TSV CLI поставка. До native операций требуется настоящий READY.

Все модели, criteria, CLI/runtime/skill/supplement pins и shared defaults прежние, кроме отдельно уже разрешённой TSV CLI candidate поставки `01a13471-39bb-7677-a48c-2fb247c3beea`. Repeats **3/10**, remaining7; reference **1,1,2,1,1,1 /3**, product0/repeat1, cold8/7/5, admission3/3, wrapper1/1, recovery0 сохраняются. Это узкое operator исключение не расширяет helper recovery/model/probe/generation budgets и не подтверждает заранее успешный settlement, unit, build/admission или Ben ACCEPT.

Перед назначением одного выполнения проверьте свежие active/queued/comment receipts, не дублируйте оператора/Rich. Сохраните фактический safe settlement receipt и archive integrity evidence отдельно; дальнейшие крупные переходы координируйте по штатному контракту. Done/merge/release остаются владельцу.
new_operator_allowance: one exact named non-model ABANDONED archival exception, consumed-before-mutation and no reset after error/crash
next_step: Evaler delegates one exact bounded operator pass; first genuine proof search and fresh full identity/process/concurrency admission; only verified ABANDONED/FREE opens normal continuation.

operator_budget.deadline: min(actual start+1800 seconds, overall stage deadline)
operator_budget.once: ATTEMPTED_BEFORE_MUTATION wx/0600; do not rename/reset/retry after error or crash; detect any prior original-incident reservation before creating a new one

scope: FIRST execute the approved byte-identical proposal on the original execution host as the same Rich owner. Search real durable terminal/typecheck/process/completion proofs; do not fabricate them or infer PASS from partial test logs.

If genuine proofs are absent, perform full fresh process/ancestry/absence checks and exact profiles/storage/container admission, check all workers and writers and repeat all owner/config/guard/capture identities immediately before mutation. Selected-name observations from the earlier report do not suffice. Current assigned Rich task itself is the sole authorized operator; no other active/queued worker is permitted. Unknown or inaccessible relevant process, original live invocation, ownership mismatch, race, pending other worker or existing destination => STOP/BLOCKED.

Create the private once ATTEMPTED_BEFORE_MUTATION proof only after all gates. Archive the whole original lease atomically as ABANDONED in the approved private destination, preserving guard, immutable owner/task/acquiredAt/config and all bytes. No individual file deletion, completion/recovery/release synthesis or completed/ archive. No changes to installed helper/supplement/runtime/defaults or foreign resources.

Deliver separate safe settlement and archive-integrity evidence, real helper FREE and exact once binding. Historical interrupted ERROR and cleanup UNKNOWN remain immutable. Archive/profiles/token/full env/DB are private and never attached. Save public file inventory hashes without secrets.

Only after verified ABANDONED integrity and actual FREE continue normal admission under fresh own acquire: genuine supervised unit/typecheck/process proofs/release and the already authorized isolated TSV source repair/build/admission. Native operations require real READY. Keep staged test-only work in rich-tsv-cli-01a134a1 and clean author partial49522; build from exact5cd and combined d68d433 patch SHA7f7a0153, no blind newer-source transplant.

Autonomous author continuation LAB57-RICH-AUTONOMY-20261012 remains in force after this major resource gate: repair local eval/harness issues and finish reference/product pilot under unchanged criteria and independent oracle. Preserve all historical FAIL/ERROR and original inputs/bytes. Candidate new CLI pin only after addressed+functional tests/typecheck/build and normal admission per owner014471; shared installed CLI/defaults unchanged.

Retain every cumulative budget: refs1,1,2,1,1,1 of3; products0/repeat1 per assigned executor; cold8/7/5; repeats3/10 remaining7, never precharge dispatch or reset on blocker/task; model admission3/3, old wrapper1/1 exhausted, helper recovery0 unchanged. Record actual usage and operator cold checks separately; reported cost is not external billing.

Operator stage at most30min from actual start; original total stage deadline2026-10-13T15:33:29.538616Z does not reset. No new action at a reached limit, address cleanup of own incomplete execution, then one checkpoint. Return one ordinary READY_FOR_BEN with clean frozen remote SHA/evidence or proven external BLOCKED; no intermediate per-fix comments, direct Ben handoff, done, merge or release decision.
